title: Mike Kafka will be Lions' pass game coordinator, Dan Skipper will be an offensive assistant

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Kafka will be Lions' pass game coordinator, Dan Skipper will be an offensive assistant
sources.description: We've known for some time that former Giants interim head coach Mike Kafka would be part of the Lions' coaching staff in 2026 and the team officially announced his title on Monday.
